english.meaning: one strip-shaped thing after another; the doubled form of the measure word 條
english.note: This meaning is less certain: it was read from a few recorded conversations.

exampleSentences.english: I don’t know. Anyway, they’re long woodlice that crawl on the ground and can’t fly.
exampleSentences.traditional: 唔知啊。總之一條條木𡃉。跟住呢，佢喺地下行，唔識飛嗰啲呢。
